en.headline: Suzhou Dongshan Precision shares fall on Hong Kong IPO debut
en.dek: The printed circuit board maker’s stock dropped as much as 6 per cent after raising about HK$9.9 billion in a listing that tested appetite for AI-related shares.
body: Suzhou Dongshan Precision Manufacturing Co. shares declined on their first day of trading in Hong Kong on Wednesday after the company completed an initial public offering that raised about HK$9.9 billion.

According to reports from the South China Morning Post and Bloomberg, the stock fell as much as 6 per cent from its listing price of HK$86.80 before recovering slightly. The company priced 113.8 million shares below the maximum of the indicative range and at a substantial discount to the previous close of its Shenzhen-listed shares.

Dongshan Precision is a major producer of printed circuit boards and supplies components used in artificial intelligence servers. Market observers noted that the soft debut occurred amid broader selling pressure on technology and hardware stocks linked to the AI sector.
The listing is among the larger Hong Kong offerings in recent months, though smaller than the size the company had initially sought.

zh.headline: 東山精密港股上市首日股價下挫 最高跌約百分之六
zh.dek: 這家印刷電路板製造商集資約99億港元後，股價較發行價一度下跌百分之六，反映投資者對人工智能相關股份的審慎態度。
body: 蘇州東山精密製造股份有限公司周三在港交所掛牌首日，股價較發行價下跌。
據《南華早報》及彭博報導，該公司以每股86.80港元定價發行1.138億股，集資約99億港元。股價開市後一度下跌達百分之六，其後稍為回穩。發行價低於招股上限，並較其深圳上市股份前收市價有明顯折讓。
東山精密是主要印刷電路板生產商，並供應人工智能伺服器所用組件。市場人士指出，上市首日表現疲弱，與近期科技及硬件股受壓有關。
是次上市屬近期港股規模較大的集資之一，但較公司最初預期的規模為小。
